decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the core cheese offer and gained its own page in 2019, so it costs little to keep and still shows positive signals, which favors keeping it.

The spicy cheese line builds on established capabilities and was promoted to its own page in 2019, so with uncertainty not yet resolved against it, keeping this low-cost option is justified even though a multi-variant line carries somewhat higher upkeep.
The mild soft cheese was highlighted at launch and given its own page in 2019, unlike the washed-rind soft cheese that was dropped, which suggests its value is being realized and it should stay.
